reference_format.note: <district prefix>/<2-digit year><CM|CC><serial>. District prefixes seen: NWB, RBC, SDC, WDC. The prefix names the district the site sits in, NOT the deciding authority — see cohort_scope. The serial length was seen only once, so no pattern is asserted.

quirks.summary: PlanIt cannot resolve this county council: auth=Warwickshire matches NORTH Warwickshire (a different, district authority) and returns its applications as though the query succeeded.
quirks.detail: 'Warwickshire County' returns a 400, so there is no working PlanIt handle for this authority at all.
quirks.workaround: Do not resolve this authority through PlanIt. Discover references with the portal's own REGFROMDATE / REGTODATE date sweep.

endpoints.note: This install's skin prefix is WCH, not the generic WPH, so the document handler is WCHDISPLAYMEDIA.showImage. theApnkey is the internal application key. Paths are relative to the portal base, /swiftlg/apas/run/.

cohort_scope.note: A COUNTY council, not a district planning authority. It determines county matters only — minerals, waste and the county council's own development. Ordinary district-level applications in the county area belong to the borough and district councils and are not on this register.
cohort_scope.excludes: All other planning applications in Warwickshire, which the district and borough councils determine on their own portals.

reference_prefixes.note: County references carry a DISTRICT prefix that identifies where the site sits, not who decided the application. An SDC/... reference on this register is a Warwickshire County Council decision about a site in that district — it is not that district council's application and must not be attributed to them.

cohort_scope.volume: Sparse — a small register compared with a district authority's.
